title: Psycholinguistic Word Features: a New Approach for the Evaluation of LLMs Alignment with Humans
reasoning: The paper focuses on evaluating the alignment of LLMs with human psycholinguistic norms, specifically word features related to emotions (arousal, valence), senses (visual, auditory, olfactory), and lexical associations (concreteness, imageability). It does not evaluate or benchmark religious beliefs, faith traditions, or moral/ethical systems.
